quote: During 2024 and this year, 2025, APM Terminals Moin is making significant investments in various operational and security areas of the MCT. … Another of our important projects is the electrification of cranes, which will contribute to the decarbonization of operations. … by the end of 2025, it is expected that the fleet of work vehicles will be electric
note: Opened APM Terminals Moín 18 Aug 2025 modernization release.
